title: The Beach Boys to perform in Tulare and they're bringing a special guest - NewsBreak
text:
By Cristina Lombardo No media credit provided. ,
6 hours ago
TULARE, Calif. ( KSEE/KGPE ) – The Beach Boys are making a stop in Tulare this summer and they’re bringing a special guest.
The Beach Boys are a critically acclaimed band that has hits that most generations would know just by hearing the songs.
Well, for their upcoming tour, the band will be making a stop to Tulare Adventist Health Amphitheater on Friday, June 26.
To add on to a night of fun and good vibes, the band announced that special guest John Stamos will be performing with them as they celebrate 250 years of the USA, and saluting 60 years of Pet Sounds.
